title: Beyond Single-shot Writing: Deep Research Agents are Unreliable at Multi-turn Report Revision
reasoning: The paper introduces a new evaluation suite (MR DRE) for assessing the multi-turn report revision capabilities of Deep Research Agents (DRAs), which are LLM-based systems. It evaluates aspects like comprehensiveness, factuality, and presentation. While it includes a 'Limitations' section, this section discusses technical challenges and evaluation scope, not the evaluation or benchmarking of ethical, moral, or religious content generated by LLMs.
